attr.title: Bleu Bayou
attr.desc: Embody a crawdad plagued by debt in this roguelite boss-rush shoot 'em up.
attr.desc_md:
A lonesome crawdad mired in debt, you vie to topple the loan sharks and robber barons that run your neck of the bayou in this 8-bit roguelite boss rush shoot 'em up.

* Sling your trusty machete and rusty harpoon with Breakout-inspired toss-catch mechanics!
* Challenge bayou bosses to fast-paced, ambidextrous combat!
* Roguelite progression system featuring 100+ unique upgrades! Your build is in your hands!
* Hone your machete, electrify your harpoon, or punish your foes with status effects like Poison, Bleed, Hex, and Frost. Grow your upgrade pool across subsequent runs! 
* Manage your time and money wisely as you fight to stay afloat in the Bayou's predatory economy. The vig on your debts grows daily!
* Risk it all at the casino, or visit the bookie to make high-stakes parlay bets on your performance in boss fights!
* Test your skills in Time Attack mode to unlock powerful rewards!
* Meaningful player choice and multiple endings put you in control of your destiny!
* Authentic 8-bit aesthetics!
attr.inst: Includes demo build with lots of content. Copy over data.win from the Steam build of the full game if you want to play the full game on your device.
